stable.notes: A task now says what finished looks like, and nothing runs until it does. Every task detail carries a finish line, and Run now is refused while it is empty, because an agent sent at a task with no definition of done cannot succeed at it and cannot be judged to have failed either. Tasks also move between three stages, Planning, Active and Review, and the detail shows the stage and moves between them. A task with no marker reads as Planning, so nothing needed migrating. Needs server 6.44.4.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
